name: Night Notifications
blurb: Night-mode brand world with drifting bokeh: every VO line gets its own literal designed-UI scene from the phone bank (cart, receipt slam, gatekept codes, TOP SECRET folder, $0.00 strike, group chat, order after order); a persistent app icon top-right whose red badge climbs on each problem line and flips to a green check after the turn; real-icon title, bright wipe out.
